artworks.title: Eine Mutter III (A Mother III)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures sitting around a table in a dimly lit room. The room is illuminated by pendant lights hanging from the ceiling, casting shadows. The walls are adorned with details and side lamps are visible. The figures appear engaged in a serious discussion or presentation, with documents and possibly books on the table.

artworks.title: Ein Mord (A Murder)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people by a crowded dockside area next to a river or canal. The individuals are engaged in different activities. There is a bridge overhead and a large building with a chimney in the background. A moored boat is to the right. The scene portrays a lively waterfront in a historical setting.

artworks.title: Pan Reclining before a Herm
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with classical sculptures and figures. The drawing features an arrangement of classical elements, including a statue on a pedestal in a wooded setting, flanked by large urns and surrounded by draped figures in leisurely poses. Dense foliage frames the composition, providing a sense of depth and a natural backdrop. The chiaroscuro effect highlights the intricate details of the figures and objects such as the ornate designs on the urns and the textured bark of the trees. The style is reminiscent of classical pastoral themes, focusing on relaxation and the eternal beauty of ancient forms.

artworks.title: The Rocky Beach and Cliffs at Fécamp
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene with a rocky shore featuring round boulders and tidal pools. The horizon is low, meeting the ocean where a small sailboat with a bright sail is visible. In the distance, a faint horizon separates the sea from the sky. On the right, tall cliffs with stratified layers are depicted in earthy browns and subtle greens. The brushwork is delicate and detailed, with softly blended watercolors in the sky transitioning from pale blues to warm creams. The color palette consists of soft, natural tones, creating a serene coastal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ancient Forum Seen Beneath an Arch
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene framed by a large stone archway. Classical structures with columns and relief sculptures fill the background, with detailed stonework in the foreground. A grand structure with carved columns and intricate detailing is prominently featured. The etching uses cross-hatching for texture, light, and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, and architectural elements and statues are visible in the distance, suggesting an urban setting. The scene emphasizes the grandeur and complexity of classical architecture through detailed perspective.

artworks.title: Dictio al Palazo di Madama
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a courtyard scene. The perspective is slightly above ground level, showing the enclosed space with high walls. The structures dominate the vertical space, leading to a central archway. The buildings have vertical lines and the surfaces show texture and depth. The engravings capture patterns and textures of the architecture and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and grey. Two figures are walking and a cart leans against a wall, suggesting historical context. The composition is bounded by tall buildings that guide the eye upward.

artworks.title: Le Couvre-feu (1er planche) (The Curfew, 1st plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a linear perspective of a paved path leading to a town or city in the distance. Buildings, including a cathedral with a tall spire, are visible on the horizon. Figures are walking along the path, some carrying umbrellas. Trees without leaves are on the right, and buildings with chimneys are on the left. The image is monochrome with detailed line work, resembling an etching.

artworks.title: A Young Man with His Hands Crossed
artworks.artist: Pietro Scattaglia and Innocente Alessandri, after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a person with medium-length tousled hair, seated with arms resting on a surface. The person has a relaxed expression, dressed in a collared garment. Their hands are gently placed on top of each other. The background is a softly textured surface, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Tah-Ro-Hon, An Ioway Warrior
artworks.artist: Alfred Hoffy, after Charles Bird King
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person turned to the right, showcasing their left profile. The person has high cheekbones, a strong jawline, deep-set eyes, and dark brown skin. Their hair is styled into a mohawk with a red plume. They wear a headband with red, green, and yellow patterns, a pink shirt with a dot pattern, and a red shawl. The person has a blue ribbon with a large medal or pendant around their neck, and large red and white earrings. They hold a patterned staff or club wrapped with red and white bands, alongside the shawl. The background is plain off-white.

artworks.title: Ki-On-Twog-Ky, or Cornplanter
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, facing forward and slightly left. They have distinct facial features with a nose ring, unique hair adorned with green and yellow feathers, traditional attire with metal ornaments on the shoulders, and a draped yellow fabric. The person holds a ceremonial object emitting smoke and colorful tassels. The background is plain light beige.

artworks.title: No-Way-Ke-Sug-Ga, Otoe
artworks.artist: Alfred Hoffy, after Charles Bird King
artworks.description: The image displays an individual from the waist up. They are seated, holding a pipe in one hand, facing slightly to the right. The person has reddish-brown skin with green face paint on parts of their face. Their hair is styled with upright, bright pink feathers. Adornments include headbands, colorful earrings, a fringed garment with green and blue embroidery, a red sash, and a large necklace. The background is a light beige color.

artworks.title: A Cartouche with Theater Masks
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate theatrical drapery. The image features a curtain being theatrically drawn apart by two sculpted figures on either side, revealing a symmetrical and decorative composition. Each figure appears draped in flowing fabric. The curtain is adorned with a variety of theatrical masks. At the apex of the drapery, a face smiles outward. Below, at the base of the composition, a collection of musical and theatrical symbols, including a lyre and open book. This drawing showcases a harmonious blend of classical motifs and theatrical symbolism.

artworks.title: Joan of Arc Hearing the Voices
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink, with white gouache and gray wash on buff paper

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Conrad and Saint Pelagius
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows three figures standing within an architectural setting with Gothic arches and decorative elements. In the center, a woman holds a child with halos around their heads. The woman appears regal, wearing a gold crown over a white veil and a red mantle with a gold lining. The child is unclothed with short hair and a halo. To the left stands a man in ecclesiastical attire with a green mitre, a golden halo, and a staff. On the right, a man in medieval clothing holds a green palm leaf, with long, blonde hair, a halo, and a pointed hat. Below, there is a crest with a gold mitre and various heraldic symbols. Two small nude figures adorn the top angles of the arch. The background is a painted architectural space with a detailed design.

artworks.title: A Rider by a Mountain Pond at Sunset
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with hills, trees, and a bird in the sky. The scene includes rocks, grass, water reflecting grassy banks, a figure on horseback with a dog, and rocky outcrops and trees in the distance. The color palette is monochrome in shades of gray.

artworks.title: Rue Grenier sur l'eau, côté de la rue des Barres
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow alleyway in a historical urban setting. The cobblestone path leads towards a distant building where a figure with a pushcart is visible. The buildings on either side are tightly packed, with one featuring an overhanging second story. Small elements like a bucket rest against the right wall. The scene is rich in texture, with intricate lines detailing the bricks and cobblestones. The monochromatic color palette creates a strong contrast between shadows and highlights, illuminating the depth and detail of the street scene.

artworks.title: Rue St. Lazare 56, Maison de Paul Delaroche et Horace Vernet
artworks.description: The image shows a building facade and an arched entrance. The view is from slightly below eye level, looking up at the architectural elements. The etching features fine lines for texture and detail, focusing on windows, doors, and masonry. The color palette is black, white, and gray. A pathway leads to stone steps and an arched doorway. Balconies with statues are visible on the left, while rooflines and an overcast sky are seen in the background.

artworks.title: Rue du Coq St. Jean
artworks.description: The image shows a historic urban scene with buildings closely packed together, featuring a tall cylindrical turret labeled "HOTEL" and wrought iron balconies. The etching style includes fine lines highlighting texture and structure, with a monochrome color palette emphasizing contrast between light and dark areas. Cobblestone pavements lead to steps with people walking on them, shops lining the street. In the background, more buildings under a textured sky complete the urban landscape.

artworks.title: Rue de la Victoire (70). Hôtel Bonaparte
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone path leading to a grand old building with textured walls and shuttered windows. There is a tree to the left of the building. The scene is depicted using fine, detailed etching strokes, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and tan. Shadows are visible on the cobblestone path.

artworks.title: Souvenir de Bretagne
artworks.description: The image is a street view of a village in a black and white illustration titled "Souvenir de Bretagne." The point of view is slightly elevated, showing two buildings with timber framing and steep roofs on either side. In the distance, houses lead up to church spires, obscuring the horizon. The sky has rolling clouds, detailed with varying brushstrokes. The scene has varying shades of grey creating a monochrome aesthetic. A small boat is seen on its side along the cobblestone street.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, after Jean-François Clermont
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and neck. The person is facing left, with distinctive facial features including a prominent nose, defined lips, and a strong jawline. Their hair is styled in voluminous curls tied at the back with a ribbon. The drawing style emphasizes the texture and volume of the hair. No visible clothing is depicted. The background has a textured, shaded pattern within a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Jacques-Onesyme Bergeret de Grancourt
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a chair. He is leaning slightly to his right, with his right arm resting on the backrest of the chair. The man has a round face with short, wavy hair. He is dressed in an 18th-century style outfit, including a long coat, waistcoat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. Beside him is a table with books visible on it. The background is softly shaded and textured.

artworks.title: Louis XIII and Anna d'Austriche
artworks.artist: Balthazar Moncornet and Pierre Mariette I
artworks.description: The image is a double portrait showing two individuals positioned side by side. On the left, a man wearing armor with a lace collar is depicted. He has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a slight smile. Surrounding him are decorations including flowers and fruits. On the right, a woman is shown from the waist up with wavy, shoulder-length hair and arched brows. She wears a dress with lace and a detailed bodice, along with a pearl necklace and earrings. The background features ornate floral imagery, drapes, ribbons, and cherub faces, enhancing the overall ornate appearance of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Joseph with the Christ Child
artworks.description: This image shows an elderly man seated or crouching while leaning over a baby. The man has a white beard and is slightly balding. He is focused on the child, and is draped in fabric. The baby is mostly unclothed and is being held in the man's arms. In the background, there is textured foliage and possibly an animal with horns in the upper left corner. The etching features detailed line work and crosshatching throughout.
